545:t_001:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$クルツ$$? What could you want that needs a private channel?」

545:t_001:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Before the operation, I wanted to pick up where we left off the other day.」

545:t_001:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Fine. I'll have $n and the others step out.」

545:t_001:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...But man, you didn't act all that surprised.」

545:t_001:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「When I was told something like that, I didn't know what kind of face to make.」

545:t_001:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You're still the same in that department. After everything with $$カナメ$$, I thought you'd have made a little progress.」

545:t_001:9.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But, see... Sis never says 'I love you.' No matter what, she won't say it.」

545:t_001:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「What do you think that means?」

545:t_001:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「It probably means she doesn't love you.」

545:t_001:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「To begin with, you're asking the wrong person.」

545:t_001:14.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...Yeah, true. But there's nobody else I can talk to. And $$マオ$$ told me never to spill it.」

545:t_001:17.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Keeping secrets within the team isn't good...」

545:t_001:20.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Take care of $$テッサ$$ for me.」

545:t_001:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm leaving the backup to you.」

545:t_002:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「To you, $$相良$$, $$ウェーバー$$ is someone special. Just as $$メリッサ$$ is to me.」

545:t_002:5.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Enemy contact at 12 o'clock! It appears to be $$アマルガム$$!」

545:t_002:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then, Captain $$テスタロッサ$$...」

545:t_002:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. I'll leave the rest to you.」

545:t_003:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「So $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ has come!」

545:t_003:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So he wasn't dead after all.」

545:t_003:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Naturally. It's too early for me to croak.」

545:t_003:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「So $$相良$$ $$宗介$$ hasn't sortied...」

545:t_003:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「If she thinks she's outwitted me with this, $$テレサ$$'s foolishness is beyond saving.」

545:t_003:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That guy... hasn't his personality changed?」

545:t_003:8.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「The situation is unclear, but he is clearly more aggressive than before.」

545:t_003:9.en:
$$レナード$$
「Never mind. After I finish you off, I'll head to $$ヤムスク１１$$ as well.」

545:t_003:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「If I take you down here, I can stop $$アマルガム$$...!」

545:t_003:12.en:
$$桂$$
「It's awkward in front of Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, but now we can do this without holding back.」

545:t_003:14.en:
$$桂$$
「So you know about me too. It's tough being a ladies' man.」

545:t_003:15.en:
$$レナード$$
「Of course. Your existence was an important factor for me as well.」

545:t_003:16.en:
$$桂$$
「Just what I'd expect from a gentleman who'd go and build a $$時空震動弾$$. You've got a different eye for things.」

545:t_003:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Our target is $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$! We stop him here and end this war!」

545:t_003:18.en:
$$レナード$$
「Try it, if you can.」

545:t_003:19.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$クルツ$$. This is our chance to try that plan!」

545:t_003:20.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「This time I'll let $$クルツ$$ and the $$妖精の目$$ have the glory.」

545:t_003:21.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Leave it to me! I'm invincible right now!」

545:t_004:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Not bad. I suppose I should say I expected no less.」

545:t_005:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Are you inviting me, $$特異点$$?」

545:t_006:0.en:
$$桂$$
(So far it's going according to the script.)

545:t_006:1.en:
$$オルソン$$
(Just as we figured, that man... has a lot of pride.)

545:t_006:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
(He's been unusually combative today, and on top of that, $$桂$$'s presence irritates him... Luck is completely on our side.)

545:t_006:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Did you think that darting machine of yours could shake off my $$ベリアル$$?」

545:t_006:5.en:
$$桂$$
「I won't deny that, but unfortunately I'm not a man who knows how to run away.」

545:t_006:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「Welcome, $$特異点$$! To think the chance to erase your existence would come to me!」

545:t_007:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Tch! Going head-on against a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ unit really was too much!」

545:t_007:2.en:
$$オルソン$$
「But his attention is on us!」

545:t_007:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The rest is yours, $$クルツ$$!」

545:t_007:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Too slow! With the $$妖精の目$$, your unit's field is wide open to me!」

545:t_007:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「From outside your awareness, one shot to finish it!」

545:t_008:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「No way... you gotta be kidding me...」

545:t_009:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Impossible! Shooting an AS through in one shot from completely outside radar range!」

545:t_009:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「A sniper! And one with godlike skill!」
